title: Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers
abstract: arXiv:2608.23446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

translated_title: 描述必要失败者以解释锦标赛败者
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23446v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究如何通过识别候选人在锦标赛中无论其余部分如何完成都会失败的子锦标赛，来正式解释为何某候选人未被特定锦标赛规则选中。我们将破坏性最小支持集定义为满足此属性的任何最小子锦标赛，在形式化可解释人工智能中，这对应于对“为什么失败者输掉锦标赛？”这一问题的溯因解释。对于六种常见的锦标赛解决方案（最大最小、未覆盖集及其加权变体、顶循环、科佩兰和波达），我们提供了候选人是必要失败者或可能获胜者的特征描述，确定了最小破坏性支持集的大小，并辅以多项式时间算法进行计算，但波达规则除外，该规则疑似为NP完全问题。
tldr: 本文为六种锦标赛规则定义了“破坏性最小支持集”来解释失败原因，并给出了特征描述和计算算法，除波达规则外均可在多项式时间内完成。
en_tdlr: This paper defines "destructive minimal supports" to explain tournament losses for six rules, providing characterizations and polynomial-time algorithms, except for Borda which is suspected NP-complete.
